svg.title: Utility Bill Audit Recovery Bands
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-utility-audit-recovery-bands; chapter number: 4; title: Utility Bill Audit Recovery Bands; subtitle: Hit rates, savings, error sizing, and fee share, in percent; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: $150,000 to $450,000 from a 1% to 3% error on $5 million of spend over three years (Daniel Burke); buckets: label: Audit Recovery Hit Rate; low: 30; high: 80; notes: Poteck Power recovers in about 30% of cases; Puleo Energy and Waste Consultants report errors or savings in about 80% of audits.; label: Average Client Savings; low: 10; high: 20; notes: Vert Energy Group says 70% of clients save 10% to 20%.; label: Billing Error Rate Modeled; low: 1; high: 3; notes: Daniel Burke's illustration across multi-year commercial and industrial spend.; label: Contingency Fee Share; low: 50; high: 50; notes: Puleo's NUR schedule: 50% of refunds received and 50% of realized savings for 24 months, 100% to the client from month 25.; caption: Commercial utility invoices are routinely wrong, errors almost always favor the utility, and the customer carries the burden before the lookback closes. Vert Energy Group and UtilityBillAudits each cite a small-business rate-plan misclassification worth $21,000.; assumptions note: Buckets mix rates on one percent scale and are not additive. Puleo reaches back about 36 months, as far as the state allows; UtilityBillAudits cites a 30-month review. Oncor's demand ratchet equals 80% of the highest peak across the current and previous 11 months.; note: Attributed to Puleo Energy (a4dO2n1QfzQ), Vert Energy Group (bQpXnGBfNJY), Daniel Burke (4pb6YRGZx4s), UtilityBillAudits (5A8gPPLuUaY, V-4ioYMhiuo), and Oncor (yHlhF0nEJ14).
